paragraphs.source_en: I have a love. — I love the stars in the sky; I love their crystalline brilliance: No divinity in this world is like this. In the sharp dusk of late winter, In the lonely gray mornings, At sea, on a mountain top after wind and rain— There is always one among the countless stars. In the woodland blossoms by the mountain stream, in the joy of children on high towers, in the lights and compasses of travelers— a spirit flashes and flashes, scintillating from ten thousand miles away. I have a shattered spirit, like a heap of broken crystal scattered among the withered grasses of the waste, sated by your instant and repeated tenderness. I have tasted life’s icy severity and its tenderness, and I have endured both. At times the autumn song of crickets below the stair, sets my heart aching and forces my tears to fall. I lay open my candid heart, and offered my love to one star of the day. Even if life is illusion or truth, whether the earth endures or fades— in space there are always incorruptible stars. Written before March, 1925.

units.source_en: — I love the stars in the sky;
I love their crystalline brilliance: No divinity in this world is like this.
units.source_zh:
我愛它們的晶瑩：

人間沒有這異樣的神明。

units.source_en: In the sharp dusk of late winter, In the lonely gray mornings, At sea, on a mountain top after wind and rain— There is always one among the countless stars.
units.source_zh:
在冷峭的暮冬的黃昏，

在寂寞的灰色的清晨，

在海上，在風雨後的山頂──

永遠有一顆，萬顆的明星！

paragraphs.source_zh:
我有一個戀愛；──

我愛天上的明星；

我愛它們的晶瑩：

人間沒有這異樣的神明。

在冷峭的暮冬的黃昏，

在寂寞的灰色的清晨，

在海上，在風雨後的山頂──

永遠有一顆，萬顆的明星！

山澗邊小草花的知心，

高樓上小孩童的歡欣，

旅行人的燈亮與南針：──

萬萬里外閃
鑠
的精靈！

我有一個破碎的魂靈，

像一堆破碎的的水晶，

散布在荒野的枯草裡──

飽啜你一瞬瞬的
殷勤
。

人生的冰激與柔情，

我也曾嘗味，我也曾容忍；

有時階砌下蟋蟀的秋吟，

引起我心傷，逼迫我淚零。

我坦露我的坦白的胸襟，

獻愛與一天的明星；

任憑人生是幻是真，

地球存在或是消泯──

太空中永遠有不昧的明星！

一九二五年三月前作
